features.text: PDAC APPROVED L4396: Certified for dynamic or static therapy to improve mobility and reduce plantar flexion contractures.
PROGRESSIVE STRETCH THERAPY: Adjustable tension straps gradually restore ankle dorsiflexion.
WEIGHT-BEARING FUNCTIONALITY: Supports standing, walking, and early gait training in rehabilitation programs.
COMFORTABLE, PRESSURE-FREE HEEL: Soft lining minimizes pressure and protects against skin irritation.
HIP ROTATION BAR: Manages internal and external hip rotation to promote proper gait and alignment.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
